For units, this deals 50 damage to them. |ability1_cooldown = 2 }} ==Description== The '''Null Missile APC''', internally referred to as '''Corrupted Missile APC''', was an enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be spawned by [[Null Commander]]. It has an ability where it will fire a barrage of four missiles in a burst. This will apply a [[Damage Debuff]] to towers, which decreases tower damage by 20% and will deal 50 damage to any unit hit. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null APC rolled forward, its mounted weapons swiveling as Null enemies poured from its rear. Rockets fired at the [[T.D.S. Organization|TDS team]], forcing [[Commander]] to yell through his radio for everyone to take cover. Seeing the APC brought back memories of his first promotion, as it was the first vehicle he ever commanded.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Missile APC''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Missile APC]]. It is greyish in colour, has spikes of the same color coming out from the sides and has a big purplish spike at the front. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]] is listed instead. *As the '''Null Missile APC''' neither stuns or debuffs towers, and due to it appearing behind the '''Null Commander''', it is quite weak, at best acting as a delayed shield for the '''Null Commander'''. **Therefore, any tower with decent DPS like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] will be enough to take it down. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Driving |- |[[File:ApcDriving.ogg]] |Driving sound |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:ApcFire.ogg]] |When the '''Null Missile APC''' performs ''Null Missile Barrage'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:ApcHit.ogg]] |When the '''Null Missile APC''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullMissileAPC.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Imagess}} Null&VoidNight1PI.png|'''Null Missile APC''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Missile APC''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullMissileAPCIconIG.png|'''Null Missile APC''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Missile APC''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Missile APC''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Missile APC''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} Missiles do nothing to towers. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Missile APC''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1b]] **'''Null Missile APC''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Missiles now apply a [[Damage Debuff]] to towers. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Outpost 16]]
